about.heading: About me
paragraphs: I believe that body and soul are in constant dialogue with each other. As a spiritual energy and soul healer, I use energy treatments and foot reflexology to accompany those who want to better understand what their body is telling them and how they can find their way back to their inner balance. Together with the people who come to me, we look at which physical and emotional processes may lie behind their symptoms. I support everyone in finding, at their own pace, the solutions that work best for them. For me this is a process that calls for presence and attention, in which I reveal the path that already lies within each guest, and help them become aware of the dormant abilities through which, by connecting to their inner Source, they can come to experience what their soul's purpose is.

As an empath, I have lived since childhood with a deep sensitivity that lets me gently attune to the inner processes of others. For more than thirty years this inner language has helped me sense deeper-rooted patterns, even those that span generations. For me, foot reflexology is a bridge: by working with the body's signals through the soles of the feet, we make room for old tensions and imprints to begin gently releasing. This is not a promise, but shared attention and guidance, at your own rhythm.

Even as a child I was strongly aware of people and the world around them. I made herbal teas, gave gentle massages and often found that pain eased. As a teenager I became more and more conscious of the subtle presence I felt in spaces and homes, and often a quiet, focused presence was enough for me to change the atmosphere of a place. Back then I could not yet name these experiences, I simply lived them; today I can see how much they shaped the path on which I now accompany people.

For more than ten years I have been accompanying people affected by cancer in finding their inner sources of support on their own path, at their own pace. I believe in cooperation. I support the people who come to me by offering complementary, supportive approaches alongside their medical care.

reflexology.heading: How Does Reflexology Work?
reflexology.text: Reflexology is a natural healing method that supports the body's self-healing processes by stimulating reflex points on the soles of the feet. Applying pressure to specific points on the sole activates their connection with the body's organs and energy systems, stimulating blood circulation and the flow of inner energy.

process.heading: What to expect from a treatment?

steps.title: 1. Booking an appointment
steps.text: Get in touch with me by phone, email or through this website, and we will arrange the details.

steps.title: 2. Consultation
steps.text: We talk through your physical and emotional processes and symptoms in depth, so that the treatment is fully tailored to you and your pace.

steps.title: 3. Treatment and relaxation
steps.text: In a calm, caring atmosphere you receive the reflexology and/or energy treatment and leave recharged in body and soul.
